description.value:
For the duration, provided you have your tech focus, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken registered language you hear. You can likewise read any written language you can see, so long as you are close enough to the surface bearing the text; reading one page takes about 1 minute.

This power does not decode ciphers or hidden messages, nor does it interpret symbols, such as ancient Sith runes, that are not part of an actual written language.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
